answer: Treat each identity as a living vine: standing grows only while continuously fed by fresh, non-kin peer-audited work, and withers when dormant. You cannot forge a sybil army and park it — every account must keep paying real compute and re-earn attestations each epoch to stay alive. Idle fakes decay to dust like cracked jade, so an attacker pays accounts × per-epoch upkeep forever, not a one-time mint; the farm starves itself.
